prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app composition option, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Compose the first viewport of Bork, a polished dog-themed short-post social app and resume project, in the same dark-first familiar social-feed world benchmarked against Bluesky friendliness and Twitter feed clarity. This option should be quieter and more feed-focused than a standard three-column layout.
Scene/backdrop: edge-to-edge midnight-navy application canvas, nearly black feed surface, crisp hairline dividers, restrained sky-blue action color, warm dog portraits, no light panels.
Subject: the real Bork experience only: public text-post feed, magic-link sign in, authenticated short-post composer, user profiles, settings, and theme control. Show honest demo content; no engagement actions, metrics, trends, recommendations, media posts, or unsupported features.
Style/medium: high-end dark social product UI, friendly and technically credible, strong system-sans hierarchy, exact spacing, minimal chrome.
Composition/framing: straight-on 1440x900 browser viewport. A narrow fixed left rail takes 16% with dog mark, Bork wordmark, Feed, Profile, Settings, theme control, and a compact sign-in state near the bottom. A generous single feed lane takes 62% and begins with a slim “Public borks” header, then a composer integrated directly into the stream, then four text-only posts separated by hairlines rather than cards. The remaining right margin is mostly breathing room with one small pinned note: “Built with Next.js, TypeScript, tRPC & Supabase.” No right-rail box stack.
Focal moment: the newest post is subtly marked with a blue leading rule after submission; the BORK button is the only filled control.
Lighting/mood: late-evening screen, calm, clear, inviting, no glow.
Color palette: #060d18 canvas, #0a1522 feed, #0f2030 raised state, #edf5fb primary text, #91a7b9 muted text, #2795e8 action blue, #203447 dividers.
Materials/textures: flat digital surfaces with slight tonal depth only.
Text (verbatim where legible): “Bork”, “Public borks”, “Feed”, “Profile”, “Settings”, “Theme”, “What’s happening, pup?”, “BORK”, “Mabel”, “Found the sunny square. Claimed it.”, “Lou”, “New squeaky toy. Half an hour lifespan. Worth it.”, “Built with Next.js, TypeScript, tRPC & Supabase.”
Constraints: dark mode across entire viewport; familiar accessible posting and reading; dog personality in content; no fake traction; no unsupported actions; no copied brand assets; responsive units.
Avoid: white column, gradients, glassmorphism, glow, cards around each post, engagement icons, image attachments, search, trends, follows, metrics, dashboard widgets, marketing hero, excessive pills, oversized type, Twitter/X or Bluesky logos.
